'''Batti''' is a girl NPC who appears in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]]. She can only be seen from 5:00 PM to 6:59 PM, talking to [[Leto]] next to a Tubpup.

''(To Be Added)

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Leto:''' I feel like I've seen that "Drama Maniac" from Egla Town somewhere before...
:'''Batti:''' He's a bit odd... but his stories about the Fool's Troupe are rather captivating!
:'''Batti:''' [[Roccia|Eccentric Roccia]] the First Mate, free-spirited [[Brant|Captain Brant]]...
:'''Leto:''' Batti, don't you think the "Drama Maniac" looks a lot like [[Lorenzo|Uncle Lorenzo]]?
:'''Leto:''' But his hair color is different, his clothes have a different style, and he wears a mask, so you can't see his face...
:'''Leto:''' But when he performs, his gaze always drifts toward us.
:'''Leto:''' Almost as if he's telling the story for our sake...
:'''Batti:''' Uncle Lorenzo went on a pilgrimage, didn't he... The adults looked so strange when he left.
:'''Leto:''' So I haven't dared mention this to Gisle—just hearing Uncle Lorenzo's name makes him sad.
:'''Batti:''' How about... we investigate it ourselves!
:'''Admiral Tubpup:''' Bark bark!
:'''Batti:''' I bet a Monnaie he's not Uncle Lorenzo!
:'''Leto:''' It's a bet!
{{Dialogue End}}
